plans.name: Hobby
plans.note: Hobby starts with a one-time $100 credit, not subtracted here, and allows 10 concurrent sandboxes.

notes: Pausing keeps memory and files at no charge; volumes and snapshots are separate.
Sandbox storage is included at no extra cost, up to 10 GiB on Hobby and 20 GiB on Pro.

Pro allows 100 concurrent sandboxes, or 600 and 1,100 with $500 and $1,000 monthly add-ons. Enterprise starts at a $2,000 monthly commit with 500 concurrent included; the Markdown pricing page still says $3,000.

upkeep.label: Updates not published
upkeep.detail: E2B publishes nothing on patching. A paused sandbox can be kept indefinitely, so a long-lived one keeps whatever software it had.

source.quote: A paused sandbox is kept indefinitely.
